skill.name: deploy
skill.description: Guides deployment setup, analytics integration, and environment health checks for web projects.
skill.summary: Set up hosting, analytics, and environment checks for web projects.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: The only static alert was a high-entropy heuristic on health-check/doc.md. Manual review found readable Markdown documentation in Japanese, with no obfuscated payload, prompt injection, credential access, or exfiltration intent.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.25 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: health-check/doc.md is readable Markdown documentation with Japanese text and a diagnostic output example, not binary or encrypted content. No encoded payload, hidden command, or instruction override was found in the reviewed content.

content.value_statement: Deployment, analytics, and environment checks often require separate setup steps. This skill guides hosting configuration, tracking integration, and health checks in one workflow.
actual_capabilities: Routes deployment, analytics, and health-check requests to focused documentation.
Guides Vercel and Netlify project setup for web applications.
Explains configuration file generation for Vercel and Netlify deployments.
Guides Google Analytics and Vercel Analytics integration.
Checks common tools, configuration files, and workflow files for environment readiness.
Covers GitHub Actions deployment automation and pull request preview deployments.
limitations: Provider accounts, billing, and production credentials remain the user's responsibility.
The documented hosting targets are Vercel and Netlify.
Analytics guidance focuses on Google Analytics and Vercel Analytics.
Health checks reference workflow files used by the surrounding harness.

use_cases.title: Launch a Web Application
use_cases.description: Prepare a project for Vercel or Netlify deployment with required configuration and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Add Product Analytics
use_cases.description: Plan Google Analytics or Vercel Analytics setup for page views, events, and conversion tracking.

use_cases.title: Check Environment Readiness
use_cases.description: Confirm required tools and workflow files before deployment or monitoring setup begins.

prompt_templates.title: Check Deployment Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this project is ready for deployment and list missing tools, configuration files, or workflow files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner environment diagnosis before release work.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Vercel Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project and guide me through a Vercel deployment setup, including environment variables and validation steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard deployment setup for a web project.

prompt_templates.title: Add Analytics Tracking
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add analytics to this project. Compare Google Analytics and Vercel Analytics, then recommend the best setup.
prompt_templates.scenario: Analytics integration for product usage tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Automate Release Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a deployment workflow with GitHub Actions, pull request previews, environment variable checks, and post-deploy verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release automation for maintained projects.

output_examples.input: Check if this repository can be deployed to Netlify.
output: Required checks: project framework, build command, publish directory, and environment variables.
Next action: create the Netlify configuration and run a deployment validation.

output_examples.input: Add analytics to my Next.js project.
output: Recommended option: Vercel Analytics for simple page view tracking.
Optional option: Google Analytics when marketing reports and conversion goals are required.
Next action: install the selected package and add tracking initialization.

output_examples.input: What is missing from my deployment environment?
output: Tools to check: Git, Node.js, npm, and GitHub CLI.
Files to check: project configuration, agent instructions, and workflow documentation.
Result: list each item as available, missing, or optional.

best_practices: Run the health check before creating deployment configuration.
Confirm environment variable names before saving provider settings.
Validate analytics events in a preview deployment before production release.
anti_patterns: Do not store provider tokens or analytics secrets in tracked files.
Do not enable production deployments before build and health checks pass.
Do not add multiple analytics systems without a clear reporting need.

faq.question: Which hosting providers does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Vercel and Netlify deployment setup.

faq.question: Can it configure analytics?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides guidance for Google Analytics and Vercel Analytics.

faq.question: Does it create provider accounts?
faq.answer: No. Users must manage provider accounts, billing, and credentials.

faq.question: Can it check my local environment?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks common tools, configuration files, and workflow files.

faq.question: Does it support CI deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for GitHub Actions and pull request preview deployments.

faq.question: Is this only for Claude Code?
faq.answer: No. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
